items.title: Oracle Looks to Raise $20 Billion to Fund AI Ambitions

items.title: Marriott Revenue Rises on Broad-Based Demand in U.S., Canada
items.teaser: Marriott International’s quarterly revenue rose, with the hotel company pointing to broad-based demand in the U.S. and Canada as well as improving travel trends in the Middle East.
